title: thymus serpyllum var. montanus
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. montanus, commonly known as Mountain Thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, a low-growing, perennial herb native to mountainous regions. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as immune system support and antimicrobial properties, which can help to prevent infections and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Thyme include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include thymol, carvacrol, and other volatile oils, which have been shown to possess antiseptic, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties.
